title: Node still uses ULA as its primary address and classifies native 02xx peers as external
description: Correctness review of python/src/lichen/node.py found Node.__post_init__ constructs Router(node_address=fd00::/64 + identity.iid) through _build_address and supplies no 0200::/7 mesh prefix. spec/04-network.md §6.1 requires the key-derived native Yggdrasil 02xx address as the sole routable primary, explicitly eliminates ULA, and says local 02xx traffic stays on LoRa. Consequently packets addressed to this node's actual yggdrasil_address are not DELIVER_LOCAL, and other native mesh peers default to EXTERNAL/RPL-parent routing instead of gradient/LOADng mesh routing. Initialize the router with yggdrasil_address(identity.pubkey), classify/configure 0200::/7 as mesh-local, remove the Node ULA helper, and add local-delivery plus isolated-mesh routing tests using key-derived addresses.
notes: Implemented in python/src/lichen/node.py: exact yggdrasil_address primary, 0200::/7 mesh classification, exact native announce gradients; focused/adjacent tests green. Awaiting 3x review; do not close yet.
